PM Modi highlights INS Mahendragiri as symbol of Atmanirbhar Bharat

Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the 136th episode of his monthly radio programme, Mann Ki Baat. He highlighted the induction of INS Mahendragiri into the Indian Navy as an example of India's progress in indigenous defence manufacturing. The Prime Minister stated that INS Mahendragiri has been designed and made in India. This was mentioned during a discussion on India's achievements in space exploration and global recognition.
